description: Phase 4 evidence: the density model and the animation/effects system, measured on the real dashboard card and the dev surface.

density.reason: CanvasPixRenderer.fit derives the backing store from the slot, never from the matrix, so cellPitch was already the only quantity resolution changed.
density.conclusion: Presentation box and canvas backing store are byte-identical across a 4x change in logical resolution. Only cellPitch moves.
density.notCssZoom: The canvas CSS size and device-pixel size are identical at every density; only the logical matrix changes.
density.cardInvarianceTest: A test renders the card at five densities and asserts the produced presentation box is the same value every time.

architecture.contentSeam: PixContent.render (full composite) and PixContent.update (continuation signal) already sufficed.
architecture.effectsAreNotStates: No *_EFFECT entries were added to the state table. A state is what the companion is; an effect is what is briefly happening to it.
architecture.effectsPostProcess: An effect has no planes, no paint order and no z-index. It modulates cells the composite already painted, so it cannot invent geometry or change what a state means.
architecture.flatPlaneModelJustification: No recorded evidence required it. Both effects are expressible as a per-cell intensity over planes that already exist.
boundariesStillEnforced: No dashboard file imports effect internals.
The adapter remains the only module importing both vocabularies.
architecture.singleDeliberateException: THINKING is authored without a loops limit, so it is held until the application withdraws it. A test proves it is the only loop that outlives its own table, and shows BLINK (also without loops) completes its pass and settles.

TASK_COMPLETE.note: Acknowledgment, deliberately quieter than a level-up

AI_THINKING.note: No effect on purpose: a pulse would imply progress

determinism.noFloatingPointDrift: Frame 5 reached by one long step equals frame 5 reached by five short ones.

bounds.proof: A test asserts the wave leaves every cell that was empty before it still empty.

reducedMotion.rule: Every reaction is shortened, never removed, and a test asserts the picture still changes.

performance.surface: Dev surface at 64x64, 652 lit cells, CPU-rasterised headless Chrome, 200 samples.

heaviestPhase4Frame.scene: THINKING looping with a sparkle wave

baselines.phase3: p50 0.3ms / p95 0.5ms on the real 110px card

performance.finding: The procedural effect costs nothing measurable; the heaviest Phase 4 scene is indistinguishable from an idle frame at the same density.

zeroWork.conclusion: Zero-work idle holds in production and is regained after a sustained animation ends.

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: The body pulse changed zero pixels.
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: cellKey returns a byte offset (four bytes per cell) because PixDisplay speaks bytes; paintBodyPulse treated it as a cell index and addressed a quarter of the real offset.
defectsFoundAndFixed.caughtBy: The reduced-motion test asserting the picture changes. Every determinism, bounds and termination test passed while the effect did nothing visible.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Divide by four bytes per cell, with cellIndexFromKey exported so the conversion is written once.

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: The content boundary scanner flagged a local variable named window.
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Three attempts to make the scanner scope-sensitive made it worse, and one broke the engine fixture asserting canvas.getContext(2d) must be flagged.
defectsFoundAndFixed.resolution: The scanner is restored to a documented plain name match. A local called window fails too, and that is the intended trade. The local was renamed to litSpan.
defectsFoundAndFixed.scope: Test layer only; no engine invariant was weakened.

visualQa.note: Card stacks; display holds its 110px box.
32/40/48/64 all pinned to the same 320px slot.

openDecisions.O1: Open, better informed, and now separable: resolution can be decided as a perceptual question with no layout cost attached.
openDecisions.O4: Open, better informed: rAF plus continuation drove a 4-beat loop, a 24-frame effect and a sustained loop unchanged. Two independent animation sources OR-ed without a scheduler change.
openDecisions.O5: Open, with negative evidence: no profiling case for a different backend.
openDecisions.O15: Open, and now has a second lever. Density can make every cell larger at the same physical size, which is a new option that should be evaluated before the slot grows or the eye design changes.
openDecisions.O16: Open, better informed: which sizes and which densities are now two decisions rather than one.
openDecisions.O17: New: whether the production card should animate at rest. Neither the Phase 3 nor Phase 4 measurement settles it, and the machinery exists.
openDecisions.O18: New: effect vocabulary growth. Whether a fifth signal needs a third effect is a question for the phase that brings the fifth signal.

limits: Live high-DPI rendering remains unobserved (O13): devicePixelRatio was 1 in every environment available.
Frame cost was measured with CPU rasterisation, not a GPU-accelerated production profile.

The four signals were verified at browser level by driving the content API the adapter drives; the mappings themselves are verified by tests. No real task, streak or AI run was triggered against production data.
Density was swept on the dev surface at a pinned 320px slot and on the card at 110px. Larger production slots were not exercised.
